tha-ap56:1.1: Gandhodaka.] Padumuttarabuddhassa mahābodhimaho ahu / vicittaghaṭam ādāya gandhodakam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap56:2.1: Nahānakāle ca bodhiyā mahāmegho pavassatha / ninnādo ca mahā ahu *asaniyā phalantiyā.* // //
tha-ap56:3.1: Tena 'vāsanivegena tattha kālakato ahaṃ / devaloke ṭhito santo imā gāthā abhās' ahaṃ: // //
tha-ap56:4.1: Aho Buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā / kalebaram me patitaṃ devaloke ramām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap56:5.1: Ubbiddhaṃ bhavanaṃ ma*yhaṃ satabhūmiṃ samuggataṃ / kaññā satasahassāni parivārenti maṃ* sadā. // //
tha-ap56:6.1: Rogā pi me na vijjanti soko mayhaṃ na vijjati / pariḷāhaṃ na passāmi puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap56:7.1: Aṭṭhavīse kappasate rājā Samvasito ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap56:8.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap56:9.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Gandhodakiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
